EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's amazing what you find when you
clean your room.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} When I saw this,
I thought of you.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Enjoy, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Or,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} um,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} if it's not your taste,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you
can just throw it away.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Es increíble la de cosas que salen
cuando limpias la casa.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} ¡Y entonces
me he acordado de ti, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Si no te gusta mi regalito, puedes
tirarlo. No me enfadaré.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Bon, c'est juste un truc que j'ai
récupéré en faisant le ménage...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Mais ça a de la valeur, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Et même s'il s'avère que ce n'est
pas le cas, il te suffira de t'en
débarrasser à ton tour...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}È incredibile cosa si trova facendo
le pulizie.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ad ogni modo, mi ha fatto
pensare a te, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Comunque, se il mio regalo non
ti piace, puoi sempre buttarlo via,
non mi offendo.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Das ist mir vorhin beim Aufräumen
in die Hände gefallen,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} und da hab ich
gleich an dich gedacht, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Viel Spaß damit! Aber wenn dir
mein Geschenk nicht gefällt, kannst
du es auch wegschmeißen oder so.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Odanı temizlerken neler bulduğuna insan
şaşırıyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bunu görünce aklıma sen
geldin.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Güle güle kullan, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ya da,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} şey,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} zevkine uymazsa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} elden
çıkarabilirsin tabii.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Whoops.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I guess I misremembered.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}But now that I mention it, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I think my
grandpa wanted one!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Sorry for the mix-up,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ah, pues ahora que lo dices...
Sí, me lo comentó otra persona.
Perdona, guap{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡La próxima vez que encuentre
alguna cosilla que pueda gustarte,
te avisaré, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oups, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}je dois confondre avec
quelqu'un d'autre, alors...? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ah oui :
mon papy, hi hi !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bon, si je trouve quelque chose
susceptible de t'intéresser, je te le
ferai savoir,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oh, ooops! Forse mi sono sbagliata.
Che sbadata! {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ora che lo dici però,
sì, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}credo che fosse{{TAG:0007:0000:03000000}} qualcun altro!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Scusami tanto{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} per la confusione,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Eyvah.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Demek yanlış hatırlamışım.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ama şimdi söyleyince aklıma geldi,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}sanırım dedem bir tane istiyordu!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Karıştırdığım için özür dilerim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}My mistake.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'll see if anyone else
in town needs one.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Benim hatam.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kasabada ihtiyacı olan
başka biri var mı diye bakarım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You're always so nice to me,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}I'm glad for this chance
to show my appreciation.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Siempre eres muy buen{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} conmigo,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Me alegro de poder
compensarte, compi!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu es toujours si sympa avec moi,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Je suis ravie de
pouvoir te rendre la pareille !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sei sempre così gentiiile con me,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sono contenta di poter
contraccambiare in qualche modo.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du bist immer so nett zu mir,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Da bin ich froh, dass
ich mich erkenntlich zeigen kann!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bana hep çok iyi davranıyorsun,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ben de sana teşekkür
edebilmek için böyle bir fırsat
bulduğuma sevindim.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Si el regalito no es de tu estilo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
puedes dárselo a alguien sin
problema.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Te prometo que no me
ofenderé,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
